_scoring.method: blind list saved to /tmp/auditA/blind_20261108_A.txt before records were opened; stored records filtered by matter_id from data/duties/{Y}.json and data/powers/{Y}.json; recall = 7 blind items matched / (9 blind items + 0 unlisted correct records)

_classes.name: quote clipped before its modal, so kind gate grant_only flips a 'shall' duty to power
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and kind_model=='duty' and kind_adjusted=='grant_only' and not re.search(r'\b(may|authori[sz]|empower|power|permit)', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: earlier chapter's sunset extension (amended act clause of a prior chapter) dropped as section_sunset or act_clause_boilerplate (Oct 16 decision says it IS a record)
_classes.rule: over data/dropped/*.json: rule in (section_sunset, act_clause_boilerplate, act_clause) and quote ~ /expire|repeal|in full force and effect until/ and the packet text before the law's own final 'This act shall take effect' clause matches /of chapter \d+ of the laws of (19|20)\d\d[^.]{0,300}is (hereby )?amended to read/ and holds braces
_classes.note: counted in dropped, not in duties/powers (8 dropped records, 8 laws: 6 section_sunset, 2 act_clause_boilerplate)

_classes.name: per-group joint actor resolved by model but stored agency collapsed to Municipalities (all)
_classes.rule: agency=='Municipalities (all)' and actor_resolved_model.lower() in {school districts, counties, towns, villages, cities, fire districts}

_classes.name: raised cap or maximum on an existing program stored extends_existing false
_classes.rule: extends_existing is False and re.search(r'(to a maximum of|up to an additional|increase[sd]? the maximum|extend the maximum)', quote, re.I)
_classes.note: regex is a candidate filter; whether a new power to raise an existing cap counts as widening needs judgment per match

_classes.name: 'take effect DATE, except that if it shall have become a law subsequent to such date ... immediately' stored as the pre-signing date
_classes.rule: effective_dates: rule=='fixed_date' and effective_date < signed_date and raw_clause ~ /subsequent to such date|after such date/
_classes.note: 14 laws (47 stored records on them); retroactive_to is already stored, so the fix is effective_date = signing date
